recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-25451 in the current core build.
issue_request: FHIR-25451 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction raised against R4 and applied for R5. It reported a typo in the token search example where the identifier modifier appeared as otype and should be of-type.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-25451 was found. The Jira comment says to mark it as a duplicate of FHIR-25385, and commit 38cfead26dd23a4261c1cfabe88975e5133d6fb5, "Apply FHIR-33422", later corrected the affected source/search.html example from identifier:otype to identifier:of-type for both GET and POST displays.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2020-01-20 mention FHIR-25385 and state that FHIR-25451 is similar, treating the item as a simple typo. The current source/search.html page is the active core search page, and source/fhir.ini's search-rules note points maintainers to the search.html summary table. The combined branch already contains c645c48234b7ac869e6d0d23d40f2c3f01f87217 for FHIR-25385, so this result audits only the seed issue.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current source defines the of-type modifier and uses identifier:of-type in both the detailed token-search example and the summary-table example; exact searches found no remaining identifier:otype, identifier:of_type, or :otype= occurrence under source/.
